description:
Property Partners Gill & Glynn together with Tom Brett Auctioneers are delighted to present this exceptional five-bedroom detached residence, a distinguished family home occupying magnificent mature grounds that offer complete privacy and a truly idyllic countryside setting.

Set behind impressive natural stone entrance walls and iron gated access, the property is approached by a sweeping tarmac driveway which extends around the house, providing generous parking and an elegant first impression. The gardens are without doubt one of this home`s defining features. Beautifully landscaped and meticulously maintained over many years, they comprise expansive manicured lawns, vibrant flower beds, mature specimen trees and an abundance of established planting that creates a peaceful and secluded sanctuary. Natural stone walls, expertly crafted stone pathways and carefully designed garden features blend seamlessly throughout the grounds, while a spacious paved patio provides the perfect setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply enjoying the tranquil surroundings.

Extending to approximately 240 sq. m., this impressive split-level residence has been thoughtfully designed to provide generous living accommodation that is both practical and welcoming.

The bright entrance hallway immediately creates a wonderful sense of space and sets the tone for the quality found throughout the home. The accommodation flows effortlessly into a series of spacious reception rooms designed for modern family living.

At the heart of the home lies a charming country-style kitchen with black granite worktops, featuring an eye-catching handcrafted red brick surround framing the cooking area, creating a warm focal point full of character. The adjoining dining area enjoys an abundance of natural light and opens directly onto the rear patio through double glazed doors, allowing the beautiful gardens to become an extension of the living space during the warmer months.

Just off the kitchen is a generous living room with attractive timber flooring, creating a comfortable everyday family space. A separate sitting room offers a more formal retreat and is full of charm, featuring an impressive timber ceiling, a handcrafted timber fireplace and large windows overlooking the mature gardens.

The accommodation is exceptionally versatile, offering five generously proportioned bedrooms, making it ideal for growing families or those requiring flexible work-from-home space. Two of the bedrooms benefit from their own ensuite bathrooms, while the principal bedroom enjoys the added luxury of a spacious walk-in wardrobe. A beautifully appointed family bathroom serves the remaining bedrooms.

A large utility room provides excellent everyday practicality and is complemented by an adjoining ensuite, featuring hollow core flooring and concrete stairs offering additional durability, flexibility and functionality for family living or guest accommodation.
Externally, every aspect of the property has been carefully considered. The mature trees provide exceptional screening and privacy, while the extensive landscaped gardens create a picturesque setting that changes beautifully throughout the seasons. From colourful flower borders and expertly laid natural stone walkways to the expansive lawns and secluded seating areas, the grounds offer an outstanding lifestyle opportunity rarely found on the market.

Combining timeless character, exceptional space, outstanding privacy and spectacular landscaped gardens, this is a home of genuine distinction that will appeal to purchasers seeking an exceptional family residence in a peaceful countryside setting. Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, craftsmanship and remarkable setting that this outstanding property has to offer.

Early viewing is highly recommended. 

Property Partners Gill & Glynn and Tom Brett Auctioneers strive to be flexible around viewings. To arrange an appointment, call, text or WhatsApp Emma Gill 087 799 9955.
